title: Annotatio IV §.XIV: Cosin — Erigerus’s witnesses; English homilies parallel to Bertram
pass_a_gloss: Yet it also had Professors and witnesses of a genuine explanation of the Sacred Supper, collected by Erigerus Abbot of Louvain, as the often-mentioned Cosin, English Bishop, reports — himself bringing into the midst Homilies of his English of that time, formerly accustomed to be read publicly even in English Churches, and alleging from those Sermons, p. 98, words exactly parallel to Bertram’s assertions:
pass_b_english: Yet it still had professors and witnesses of a genuine Supper explanation, collected by Erigerus of Louvain.
Cosin (English bishop) brings into the midst English homilies once read publicly in churches — words at p. 98 exactly parallel to Bertram.
source_text: Habuit tamen etiam genuina de S. Cœna explicationis Professores & testes, ab Erigero Abbate Loviensi congestos, uti refert sæpè memoratus Cosinus Episcopus Anglus, ipsemet Anglorum suorum istius temporis Homilias, publice etiam in Ecclesiis Anglicis olim legi solitas, in medium adducens & ex Concionibus istis, p. 98. verba allegans, Bertrami assertis exacte parallela:
